memory.summary:
On December 12th, Andy has several conversations. First, he discusses AI with Samantha at the museum at 8 AM and agrees to meet her at Caroline's Café the next day at 3 PM. Later that day, he talks to Leo at home around noon, proposing a meeting at Caroline's Café the same day at 1 PM to discuss their AI project. Later in the afternoon, Andy talks to Diego at the gym around 4 PM and invites him for a coffee meeting tomorrow (December 13th) at Caroline's Café at 3 PM to discuss shared interests including the AI project, community garden meeting, and strays at the park. Diego agrees to bring his noise-cancelling headphones.

In a later conversation at the market on December 12th at 5 PM, Andy talks to Samantha about their AI project. Samantha tells him she made progress with Noor on an idea for an AI mural fusion and invites Andy to join them for a discussion this afternoon at Caroline's Café at 1 PM.
